newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia beheads Saudi man for drugs, rape.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia beheads Saudi man for drugs, rape.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Friday beheaded a Saudi man for organising a drug party and raping a woman, the Saudi Interior Ministry said.
A ministry statement carried by the official Saudi Press Agency said the man, a repeat offender, was publicly executed in the holy city of Mecca.

His head was chopped off with a sword after a court found him guilty of gathering a number of friends at a house to take heroin and pills, raping a woman and encouraging them to rape her also, it said.
One of the men had died after taking drugs, it added.
The executed man had previous convictions for drinking alcohol, strictly banned in the conservative Islamic kingdom, and pushing drugs, the statement said.
The execution raised to 33 the number of people put to death this year in Saudi Arabia, which enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, drug smugglers and rapists.
